title: Cansado de farmar na mão?
concept: 90s/2000s TV-shopping parody: a black-and-white 'problem' scene (a tired player still farming by hand at 03:47, eyes closing) bursts into color with 'SEUS PROBLEMAS ACABARAM!', KizuBot spins in on a turntable, Caça! Captura! Pesca! pop as starbursts, a real alarm print proves 'Avisa no WhatsApp!', 'MAS ESPERA…' leads to 'funciona com o PC desligado!', then the price card and the end card; the TV switches off to loop back to the B&W hook.
claims: caça, captura e pesca sozinho (módulos Combat, Catch, Fishing)
alarmes no celular e notificações no WhatsApp
menos de R$ 9 por dia (R$ 250 ÷ 30 = R$ 8,33)

pinned_comment: Quem lembra dos comerciais da madrugada? 📺
notes: Deviations: the B&W hook uses an illustrated tired gamer (clearly a dramatization) with an LED clock 03:12→03:47 instead of a click counter, to tie into 'comerciais da madrugada'. No 'OFERTA!' starburst (there is no offer); the starburst says '100% AFK!'. Added the real alarm print boss-tangrowth-electivire--tangrowth.png (tagged 'print real de cliente', shows 'KizuBot™ | kizubot.com') as proof for 'Avisa no WhatsApp!'. Price card 'planos a partir de R$ 250 por mês' plus 'menos de R$ 9 por dia'; no valor total, no de/por, no countdown, no scarcity. 'LINK NA BIO' lower third replaces the 0800 number. On-screen ask is the pinned question as a question ('Lembra dos comerciais da madrugada?'). Loop bridge: the TV switches off (black < 0.3 s). Rendered 3 times: renders 2 and 3 only re-built the audio for the shared AAC true-peak guard fix (final TP -1.6 dBFS).
